name: Bionicle: Quest for Mata Nui
summary: BIONICLE: Quest for Mata Nui was a fan-made BIONICLE open-world RPG, developed as a mod for Starcraft 2. It retells the 2001 story of the Toa Mata's quest for the Kanohi Masks of Power, culminating in their battle against Makuta.
